3099-4824-6006.description:
Activate Soliton by tapping it, adding {U}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Soliton by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.
3099-4824-6006.notes: Once you have infinite green mana, you may activate Leyline of Abundance any number of times, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on creatures you control.

2445-2921-5254.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
2445-2921-5254.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the creature with power 4 or greater.
When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio
Repeat.

1385-1981-2415-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing a creature
When the creature dies, Zulaport Cutthroat and Havoc Jester trigger.
Resolve the Zulaport Cutthroat trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Havoc Jester trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling the targeted player a number of cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

5078-5901-6666.easyPrerequisites: Artist's Talent is at least level 2.
5078-5901-6666.description:
Cast Sensei's Divining Top by paying {0} due to Artist's Talent.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Rook Turret triggers.
Holding priority, activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Resolve the Rook Turret trigger, causing you to draw Sensei's Divining Top from your library, and then discard a card other than Sensei's Divining Top.
Repeat

967-2438-3809-7087-7824.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Flameskull.
When Flameskull dies, it triggers, exiling it and the top card of your library with the ability to cast one from exile this turn.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Cast Flameskull from exile by paying {1}{R}{R}.
Prosper's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {2}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

3259-3699-7175.notablePrerequisites:
At least one opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control a creature token.
3259-3699-7175.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached and Cadira, triggering Breath of Fury and Cadira.
Resolve the Cadira trigger, creating at least one creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

232-1770-5778-6867.description:
Cast Priest of Urabrask by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice due to Elesh Norn.
Resolve both innate Priest of Urabrask triggers, adding six {R}.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Priest of Urabrask that is 1/1.
When the Priest of Urabrask token enters, it triggers twice, adding six {R}.
Repeat steps 4 and 5 for the remaining offspring trigger.
Cast Appa by paying its mana cost plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
When Appa enters, it triggers twice and its offspring ability triggers twice.
Resolve both innate Appa triggers, airbending the nontoken Priest of Urabrask.
Resolve the first offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending nothing.
Resolve the second offspring trigger, creating a token copy of Appa that is 1/1.
Put the Appa token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
The Appa token's enter-the-battlefield ability triggers, airbending the nontoken Appa.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat steps 2 through 6 once.
Cast Appa from exile by paying {2} plus an additional {2} for its offspring cost.
Repeat from step 8.
232-1770-5778-6867.notes: Once you have extra mana, other nonland permanents can be airbended using Appa and returned to the battlefield each loop as desired.

1806-1887-2060-5231-7367.description:
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability, granted to it by Young Deathclaws, by paying {3} and exiling Eternal Scourge from your graveyard, putting six +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Vorinclex.
Activate Crystalline Crawler six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Eternal Scourge.
Repeat.

2034-5359-7282.description:
Activate Chrome Dome by paying {5}, creating a token copy of Threefold Thunderhulk with haste.
When Threefold Thunderhulk enters, it triggers, creating three creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar three times by sacrificing three creature tokens, adding six {C}.
Repeat from step 2.

1453-2387-3490-7296.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to put a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
1453-2387-3490-7296.description:
Put a +1/+1 counter on a creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Animation Module triggers. Holding priority, activate the Servo by tapping it, adding {1}.
Resolve the Animation Module trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token that enters with a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to Arwen's toughness.
Repeat from step 3.

560-5086-5183-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
560-5086-5183-5231-6824.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Triskelavus
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing another creature token, adding {R}.
Repeat from step 1.

851-1409-3671.description:
Activate Wily Goblin by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Wily Goblin enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Wily Goblin.
Resolve the Wily Goblin trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

107-2438-6972.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Ambitious Aetherborn.
When Ambitious Aetherborn dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Ambitious Aetherborn enters, its fabricate ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

132-1268-3053.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four basic land types among lands you control
132-1268-3053.description:
Activate Myr Welder using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least {3}{U}.
Activate Crab Umbra by paying {2}{U}, untapping Myr Welder.
Repeat.

1395-5078-6289.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat

3054-4050-6121.easyPrerequisites: You have gained life this turn.
3054-4050-6121.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Oathsworn Vampire, adding {B}.
Cast Oathsworn Vampire from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.

1363-1636-4022.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature,
1363-1636-4022.notablePrerequisites: A permanent you control has left the battlefield this turn.
1363-1636-4022.description:
Cast Hidden Herbalists by paying {1}{G}
When Hidden Herbalists enters the battlefield, it and Intruder Alarm trigger.
Resolve the Hidden Herbalists trigger, adding {G}{G}.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Activate Tradewind Rider by tapping it, Hidden Herbalists and one other creature you control, returning Hidden Herbalists from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1363-1636-4022.notes: If you control creature(s) that can tap to produce mana, you can use that mana to pay for the creature and instead gain mana from the creature's ETB ability.

1768-4659-5003-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
1768-4659-5003-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Mister Gutsy enters the battlefield, Juniper Order Ranger triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mister Gutsy and Juniper Order Ranger.
Repeat.

5070-5670-6291.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one additional creature.
Your life total is at least 2.
5070-5670-6291.description:
Activate Warren Soultrader by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature, creating a Treasure token and a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters the battlefield, Angelic Chorus triggers, causing you to gain 2 life.
Repeat.

1115-1170-1171.description:
Activate Garth One-Eye by tapping it, causing you to pay {0} to cast a copy of Black Lotus without paying its mana cost.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Garth One-Eye.
Repeat.
1115-1170-1171.notes: Once you have infinite Black Lotus tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite mana, and then cast any other card except Shivan Dragon using Garth One-Eye's ability.

4826-5413-5720-5721.notablePrerequisites:
There are at least four card types among cards in your graveyard.
Lands you control and/or land cards in your graveyard that enter the battlefield untapped can tap to produce at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
4826-5413-5720-5721.description:
Activate Trenching Steed by sacrificing any land except Shifting Woodland.
Repeat step 1 until you control no other lands except Shifting Woodland.
Activate Shifting Woodland's second ability by paying {2}{G}{G}, causing it to become a copy of Aftermath Analyst until end of turn.
Activate Shifting Woodland by paying {3}{G} and sacrificing it, returning it and all other land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Activate any number of lands by tapping them, adding at least {5}{G}{G}{G}.
Repeat.

439-4050-4766-5683.notablePrerequisites:
All permanents on the battlefield.
Deathrender attached to Arashin Sovereign.
439-4050-4766-5683.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Arashin Sovereign, adding one mana of any color.
When Arashin Sovereign dies, it, Deathrender and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Arashin Sovereign trigger, causing you to put it on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, causing you to search your library for Arashin Sovereign and put it into your hand.
Resolve the Deathrender trigger, putting Arashin Sovereign from your hand onto the battlefield, and attaching Deathrender to it.
Repeat.

396-851-2034-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking any other nontoken creature you control.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Blessed Sanctuary triggers, creating two 2/2 Unicorn creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the Unicorns, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2034-3321-4985-5220.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Filigree Familiar, adding {C}{C}.
When Filigree Familiar dies, its second ability and Mortuary trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Filigree Familiar on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Filigree Familiar trigger, causing you to draw Filigree Familiar.
Cast Filigree Familiar by paying {2}.
When Filigree Familiar enters the battlefield, its first ability triggers, causing you to gain two life.
Repeat.

1736-2034-5003.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Ponyback Brigade, adding {C}{C}.
Ponyback Brigade dies, triggering Nim Deathmantle, causing you to pay {4} to return Ponyback Brigade from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Ponyback Brigade enters the battlefield, creating three 1/1 Goblin creature tokens.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a Goblin, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1387-2871-3809.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {1}{R}, targeting Goldspan Dragon.
Goldspan Dragon triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Seething Anger, giving Goldspan Dragon +3/+0 until end of turn and returning Seething Anger to your hand.
Activate the Treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}{R}.
Repeat.

1300-2645-2826.notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Harmony does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least five other Shrines.
1300-2645-2826.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest triggers.
Holding priority, activate Weaver of Harmony by paying {G} and tapping it, copying Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability.
Resolve the copy of Sanctum of Fruitful Harvest's ability, adding at least six {G}.
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Weaver of Harmony.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat from step 2.

65-717-881-2628-4652.description:
Activate Scattered Groves's cycling ability by paying {0} and discarding it.
Bone Miser, Scattered Groves, and Escape Protocol trigger.
Resolve the Bone Miser trigger, adding {B}{B}.
Resolve the Scattered Groves trigger, drawing a card.
Resolve the Escape Protocol trigger, causing you to pay {1} to blink Tilling Treefolk.
Tilling Treefolk enters the battlefield, returning Scattered Groves and up to one other land from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
